scope: Eight of the 38 actual core direction tools; not a US geolocated Google SERP ranking export

items.gap: Fundamental conversion functionality and table already covered by rival; cannot claim unique ranking advantage.

items.exactunit: Correct international foot factor, decimal-feet explanation and foot-to-meter static reference.
items.gap: Primary intent already well served. Existing ExactUnit differentiator mixed feet/inches is a convenience, not verified SERP advantage.

items.evidence: Calculator, US fluid ounce definition, separate imperial fluid-ounce definition, exact factors and conversion table.
items.exactunit: US and imperial fluid ounces are visibly separated with consistent source factor and live input.
items.gap: Rival covers core definitions; retain US/UK emphasis without adding repeated standalone numeric pages.

items.evidence: Formula with offset, examples and comprehensive Celsius/Fahrenheit temperature table.
items.exactunit: Live Fahrenheit, Celsius, Kelvin readout with absolute-zero validation and rounding.
items.gap: Competitor satisfies ordinary Celsius-to-Fahrenheit intent. Three-scale output is not a verified unique SEO acquisition claim.

items.evidence: Bidirectional speed conversion, precise statute mile definition and wide unit-pair value table.
items.exactunit: Live km/h, mph, m/s and knot equivalents with exact international statute/nautical-mile definitions.
items.gap: Competitor has accurate speed conversion and reference table. Another 330 numeric SEO page needs separate evidence.

items.evidence: Interactive torque conversion, equation, example values, table and difference between torque and joules.
items.exactunit: Live N·m, ft·lbf, in·lbf, kgf·m and conversion safety context.
items.gap: Main direction page function is real but not exclusive; no further torque-number-page growth justified.

items.evidence: One converter displays 4 distinct horsepower conventions: mechanical, electric, metric and boiler, each with different watts-per-horsepower factor and parallel table.
items.exactunit: The core engine supports MECHANICAL hp only; V28 adds a static comparison for the other three standards and unmistakable mechanical-only scope.
items.gap: Before V28 it was unclear to users why hp(E), hp(M), or boiler hp results could differ. A comparison table resolves that actual definitional gap without pretending the live calculator supports four standards.

items.evidence: Calculator returns decimal hours and whole hours/minutes, explains the 60-minute denominator and provides conversion table.
items.exactunit: Live minutes/hours converter plus elapsed HH:MM:SS readout, CSV and reference table.
items.gap: Clock-style duration is competitor parity, not an independent differentiation proof. Avoid adding more template paragraphs.
